toegepas.voor: om alleen aan te trek of te was
toegepas.na: om jou alleen aan te trek of te was
toegepas.rede_vinder: Standard Afrikaans uses the reflexive 'jou aantrek' and 'jou was' for dressing and washing oneself; one 'jou' covers both verbs.
toegepas.fout: 'aantrek' and 'was' for dressing and washing oneself need the reflexive 'jou' in standard Afrikaans; without it the infinitives read incomplete.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding the reflexive fixes the grammar and leaves the permission, its condition 'waar dit kan' and who acts unchanged.

laat_vaar.voor: en nie sommer aangeraak te word nie
laat_vaar.na: en om nie sommer aangeraak te word nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Repeating 'om' makes the two parts of the right parallel, so the second part clearly belongs to 'Jou reg'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original glossary definition is grammatical, because one 'om' can govern both infinitives; adding a second is a lateral change to a definition that only the writer may reword.

na_skrywer.voor: Sê dit steeds as iemand jou gevra het om stil te bly.
na_skrywer.na: Sê dit selfs as iemand jou gevra het om stil te bly.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'steeds as' calques English 'still ... if'; 'selfs as' is the natural Afrikaans for 'even if' with the same meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: 'steeds as' copies English 'still ... if' and reads stiffly.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this sentence is a safety instruction about when to tell, and swapping the operative particle 'steeds' (keep on, nevertheless) for 'selfs' (even if) changes its wording, so the writer has to own the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
